description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the GatewayConnection component, including mocks for WebSocket tasks and sessions, and test cases for checking connection status and message rejection.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking used for testing, simulating WebSocket behavior with basic state management and error throwing.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session providing a method to create WebSocket tasks, using the FakeWebSocketTask.

methods.name: makeTestGatewayConnection
methods.description: Helper function to instantiate a GatewayConnection with mocked WebSocket session for testing.
